A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Curiosity
looks good on you.

Can the robot be customized for my event?+

Yes, customization and programming are part of our rental service. Tell us what you want the robot to do. We’ll assess the specific platform, equipment and operating requirements before confirming the activity.

How much does a rental cost?+

Ask us for a proposal based on the robot, rental duration, programming, location and support needed. Transportation, setup, operator support and taxes are confirmed separately.

Can I rent a robot for a school?+

We discuss educational demonstrations and school experiences. The activities, supervision and venue requirements are agreed before the booking is confirmed.

Does an enquiry confirm my booking?+

No. Dates, availability, operating scope and commercial terms need written confirmation from the team.
